description.en: Kimi for Claude Code, Codex, and DeepSeek Harness: code questions, independent reviews, bounded fixes, autonomous goals, parallel tasks, and MCP tools through your local Kimi Code CLI. Available through GitHub marketplaces and npm.
鱼搭子：桌面小鲸鱼挂件 + DSH 插件（语音送话、陪看字幕、游戏弹幕、截图）
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: 把 Qoder 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness：用 PAT 调用与 Qoder CLI 同源的模型服务，支持国内版 / 国际版双区域、模型开关、上下文窗口与每日签到，并提供只读的额度概览。
description.zh: 粘贴 PAT 就能在 DSH 里直接用 Qoder 模型，支持双区域、模型开关和额度查看。

description.en: Safety-gated SSH development plugin for DeepSeek Harness and MCP, built for GPU and offline laboratory servers.
Liquid glass for DeepSeek Harness: full-shell translucency, adjustable opacity, and custom wallpapers.

API-key-free aggregate search (16 domestic+overseas engines with result-layer failure filtering) plus direct target-URL fetch with SSRF protection, as providers for the DeepSeek Harness web seam (ctx.web).
为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 3D 智能体工作轨迹可视化插件。A 3D agent-work trajectory visualization plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
Drive the desktop and Chrome from DeepSeek Harness using the computer-use runtime inside the ChatGPT desktop application.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 通过 LCU 直接操控桌面和 Chrome，不用打开应用就能自动干活。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 截图插件：输入框入口、隐藏/保留本窗口截图、窗口边缘自动吸附框选、截图直接插入对话框
DSH 设置页内统一管理 MCP 服务器与技能(Skills):增删改、启停、hmr 热生效,写盘保留注释。内置 OAuth 2.1 + PKCE 授权链路。
DSH 心跳：按时间规则向指定会话的主 Agent 主动投递一条你自己写的提示；模型输出期间不计时

A DeepSeek Harness bundle adapted from whatcccup/cece_legal_skills (MIT) for local DOCX, PDF, TXT and Markdown redaction with human review, PDF masking, local history and optional Agent rule edits. Requires Python 3.9+ and first-run dependency downloads. Model access is needed only for rule generation; 1.3.0 is a development prerelease and Windows acceptance is pending. The upstream is a standalone offline tool/SkillHub skill, not a DSH plugin, so it cannot be installed alongside this bundle.
description.zh: 在 whatcccup/cece_legal_skills（MIT）基础上适配的 DeepSeek Harness 文书脱敏插件，提供本地识别、人工复核、PDF 框选遮盖、历史记录与可选 Agent 改规则。需 Python 3.9+，首次准备依赖需要联网；仅规则生成需要模型。1.3.0 为开发预发布，Windows 待实机验收；上游是独立离线工具/SkillHub 技能，不是 DSH 插件，无法在 DSH 内与本插件同装。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin adding an OKX perpetual-futures price dashboard: BTC/ETH candlesticks at 1m/3m/15m/1h/4h/1D, EMA overlays, line/Fibonacci/ruler drawing tools, close-line alerts through desktop notification, sound or email (email delivery additionally needs the dsh-qq-email plugin), and an in-panel backtester. Market data comes from OKX public endpoints and no API key is required.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 OKX 永续合约看板插件：BTC/ETH 的 1m/3m/15m/1h/4h/1D K 线、EMA 均线叠加、直线/斐波那契/尺子画线、收线预警（桌面通知/提示音/邮件；邮件通道需另装 dsh-qq-email 插件）与面板内回测。行情来自 OKX 公开接口，不需要 API key。

description.en: Adds personality injection, a decaying memory card, a mood state and a daily diary so the agent keeps identity and history across sessions.
description.zh: 给 agent 加人格注入、会衰减的记忆卡、心情状态和每日日记，让它跨会话保留身份和历史。

description.en: Archived-session trash with batch move, restore and permanent deletion, plus DSH and workspace storage usage, file types and large-file views.
description.zh: 归档会话回收站，支持批量移入、恢复和永久清除，并展示 DSH 与工作区的存储用量、文件类型和大文件。

description.en: Manage and delete archived DSH conversations: a Settings page lists every archived session with per-row and bulk delete, and the sidebar session menu gains a Delete row next to Unarchive. Deletion is real — the session log, its projection cache and both indexes are cleaned up, not just an unarchive.
description.zh: 管理并删除已归档的 DSH 对话：设置里新增「归档会话」页，列出所有归档会话，支持单条与批量删除；侧边栏会话「…」菜单在「取消归档」旁新增红色的「删除归档会话」。删除是真正的删除（会话日志、投影缓存与两套索引一起清理），不只是取消归档。

description.en: Browser takeover for sign-in-gated sites: keeps a list of addresses that need a login (URL and date only, no credentials), answers before a visit whether an address is already on it, reports whether the debug browser is signed in there from the session-cookie names of that site (certain, likely, or not signed in — anonymous cookies such as _gh_sess never count), and opens saved addresses in that browser by navigating and clicking one element by its visible text, searching every iframe. One click per call, no crawling.
description.zh: 浏览器网址接管：维护一份「要登录的网址」清单（只存网址与添加时间，不存账号密码），访问前先回答这条地址在不在清单里；按该站点的会话 cookie 名字判断调试浏览器此刻是否已登录（确定／可能／未登录，_gh_sess 这类匿名 cookie 不计），在带调试端口的浏览器里打开清单中的地址，并按可见文字点击一个元素（会搜索所有 iframe）。一次调用最多点一个元素，不做批量爬取。

description.en: Host-side plugin that links the Cindy mobile app to DSH: phone channels for sessions, messages, approvals, todos and goals, plus a settings card.
description.zh: Host 侧插件：将 Cindy 手机客户端接入 DSH，提供会话、消息、审批、todo、goal 的手机通道，以及配套的设置卡片。

description.en: Keeps DeepSeek Harness desktop dsh-auth-* session cookies bounded by deleting stale ones during the token exchange performed on every launch, so random-port accumulation cannot reach the 16 KiB request-header limit and cause an HTTP 431 startup failure.
description.zh: 在每次启动的令牌交换中删除多余的 dsh-auth-* 会话 cookie，让 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端的 cookie 数量保持在 3 条以内，避免随机端口累积达到 16 KiB 请求头上限而出现 HTTP 431 启动失败。

description.en: Data cleanup and reconciliation for dsh, built around reviewable evidence: original sources stay read-only, a cell is accepted only after independent checks agree, and every accepted value keeps its provenance and audit trail.
description.zh: 用于数据核对与清洗的 dsh 插件：原始材料保持只读，一格数据只有在多个独立校验一致后才被接受，每个接受值都保留来源与审计痕迹。

description.en: Manage GitHub and npm from inside DeepSeek Harness: multi-account switching, repository management, workspace Git tree with one-click push, pre-push Agent review, and npm package browsing, packing, pre-publish review and publishing.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里统一管理 GitHub 与 npm：多账号切换、仓库管理、工作区 Git 版本树与一键推送、推送前 Agent 审查，以及 npm 包的浏览、打包、发布前审查与发布。

description.en: Autonomous Douyin watching in a dedicated Edge browser on Windows (requires Node.js 22.13+): sampling decisions, frame storyboards, danmaku-aware comments, persona memory and a watch diary, all under daily viewing limits. Fork of LockyBee/dsh-douyin-agent — uninstall the upstream plugin before installing this one.
description.zh: 在 Windows 的专用 Edge 浏览器里自主刷抖音（需 Node.js 22.13+）：采样决策、抽帧拼故事板、带时间的高赞弹幕、人格与兴趣记忆、观看日报，全程受每日时段与额度限制。改自 LockyBee/dsh-douyin-agent，不能与上游同装。

description.en: A Web3D energy orb decoration for the DSH Web GUI: a particle core wrapped in three mechanical rings that shrinks and falls silent while the session is idle and pulses in a double-beat heartbeat while a turn runs. UnrealBloom glow, draggable with its corner, position and size remembered, and three.js served locally by the plugin instead of a CDN.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Web3D 能量球装饰：粒子核心外包三圈机械环，会话静息时收缩沉默、回合运行时以双拍心跳涨缩。UnrealBloom 辉光；可拖动，所在一角、位置与尺寸都会被记住；three.js 由插件本地提供，不走 CDN。

description.en: Security plugin that intercepts file deletion and write commands, requiring user token authorization.
description.zh: 文件守卫：拦截危险的文件删除/写入命令，需用户提供 token 才放行。

description.en: A transparent always-on-top desktop pet that chats through the host model, plays animations on click, whispers on a timer, narrates task progress, and shows account balance. Runs in the DSH Desktop app using its bundled Electron runtime (~/.dsh/electron); the pet does not appear if that runtime is missing. Windows only.
description.zh: 透明置顶的桌面桌宠：走宿主模型聊天、点击切换动画、定时碎碎念、按会话播报任务进度，并可查询账户余额。依赖 DSH Desktop 自带的 Electron 运行时（~/.dsh/electron），缺失时桌宠不会出现；仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Reports conflicting DeepSeek Harness plugin composition — duplicate loader names across bundles (install-shadow), one id given two names, enable/disable fights, and config keys silently overwritten by a later layer — then emits a patch with the final merged values. Ships a CLI that runs when DSH itself will not boot, plus a fusion_report tool that reads the live loader.
description.zh: 检查 DeepSeek Harness 插件装配层的冲突：跨 bundle 重复的 loader 名（install-shadow）、同一个 id 被写成两个 name、一层要开一层要关、以及被后一层静默覆盖的配置键，并把覆盖合成终值补丁。带一条 DSH 起不来时也能跑的 CLI，另有一个会读运行时 loader 的 fusion_report 工具。

description.en: Schedules a daily, weekly or monthly GitHub Trending digest, has a local trendradar core write Chinese summaries and period recaps, commits them to your own repo and opens the pull request, and shows an overview, digest, run history, subscription and settings workbench.
description.zh: 按日 / 周 / 月周期定时生成 GitHub 趋势日报，由本地 trendradar 核心写中文简介与周期总结、提交到你自己的仓库并开 PR，内置概览 / 榜单 / 运行记录 / 订阅 / 设置工作台。

description.en: Agent tools for a local Gopeed downloader: create, inspect, pause, resume and remove downloads, diagnose or launch the Gopeed process, and receive download-complete events through a DSH background job that wakes an idle agent. Process diagnostics and launching are Windows-only; the download tools work wherever Gopeed runs.
description.zh: 把本机 Gopeed 下载器接进 DSH 的 agent 工具：新建、查看、暂停、继续、删除下载任务，诊断或启动 Gopeed 进程，并通过 DSH 后台任务接收下载完成事件（空闲的 agent 会被唤醒）。进程诊断与启动仅支持 Windows，下载相关工具跨平台可用。

description.en: Edit user messages and add or remove attachments inline, with settings to fork a conversation or regenerate its latest eligible task-starting message in place.
description.zh: 原地修改用户消息文字及增删附件，可在设置中选择新建分支，或在当前对话重新生成最近一条符合条件的任务主消息。

description.en: Desktop-pet lab assistant for DSH that keeps experiment records, accumulates per-software notes, and generates Word/Markdown lab reports from real step-by-step evidence. The desktop pet and lab panel require the Windows desktop build of DSH; other profiles get the conversational tools only.
description.zh: 面向高校实验课程的 DSH 桌宠式插件：保存实验档案、按软件累积经验、用真实步骤证据生成 Word/Markdown 实验报告，并提供黄色高框指引与「点一下自动判对错」的教学循环。桌宠与实验助手面板仅在 Windows 桌面端出现，其他环境只有对话工具可用。

description.en: Local long-term memory for DSH sessions: archives older turns under context pressure, with four tiered hot-memory boards, project documents, memory families and root transfer, manual injection, 20K segmented reads, and tag-related retrieval. All data stays in the workspace.
description.zh: DSH 会话的本地长期记忆：上下文压力升高时归档较早轮次，提供四板块分级热记忆、项目档案、记忆家族与根转移、手动注入、20K 分段读取和 tag 关联检索；数据都保存在工作区。

description.en: DeepSeek App-style mobile shell for the DSH Web UI with drawer navigation, app-like composer and settings; best paired with the dsh-android app, which supplies the native Android back key (standalone use works but is not recommended).
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供接近 DeepSeek App 的移动端壳层：抽屉导航、App 风格输入与设置；Android 返回键需搭配 dsh-android App（单独安装也能用，但作者不建议且可能有 bug）。

description.en: Manage which models appear in the composer model menu. A settings page lists the models of every provider with a per-model switch, provider-level show/hide and filters by kind; switched-off models leave the menu while the model in use in the current session stays. Rows show the model kind, and chat models also show reasoning support and the adapter's effort levels, their context window and input modalities. Labels merge six sources in priority order (settings document, adapter, the relay's GET /models response, a built-in pi-ai / models.dev catalog, name inference, vendor corrections), with the source named on hover and dashed borders marking inferred values. A switch, on by default, lets relay routes whose models declare text-only input accept images in memory, without editing configuration files. The hidden list is stored in the profile patch and mirrored to $DSH_HOME.
description.zh: 管理哪些模型出现在输入框的模型菜单里。设置页按 Provider 列出模型，支持逐模型开关、渠道级批量显隐和按类型筛选；关闭的模型从菜单中消失，当前会话正在使用的模型保留。每行标注模型类型，对话模型另外标注是否支持推理、适配器公布的思考强度档位、上下文窗口和输入模态。标签按六个来源的优先级合并（设置文档、适配器、中转站 GET /models 响应、内置 pi-ai / models.dev 目录、模型名推断、厂商校正），悬停显示来源，虚线边框表示推断值。一个默认开启的开关让声明纯文本输入的中转站模型真正能接收图片，只在内存里生效，不改配置文件。隐藏列表保存在 profile patch 中，并镜像到 $DSH_HOME。

description.en: Tracks an AI companion’s emotion and personality with a status panel, update tools, and chat stickers.
description.zh: 通过状态面板、更新工具和聊天表情包管理 AI 搭档的情绪与性格。

description.en: Lets a phone reach the DeepSeek Harness desktop over a LAN address or a Cloudflare quick tunnel, with QR pairing, a live session feed, approval prompts and a floating desktop widget. Both entry points (LAN and the Cloudflare quick tunnel) start enabled by default; each phone pairs with its own token.
description.zh: 让手机连上本机的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版：局域网或 Cloudflare 隧道二维码配对，实时消息列表与授权提醒，桌面悬浮球。局域网与 Cloudflare 隧道两个入口默认都开启；每台手机用自己的配对令牌。

description.en: Connects QQ private chats and groups to DSH over OneBot 11, adding qq_send and other tools so the agent can reply, send stickers and wait for follow-ups.
description.zh: 经 OneBot 11 把 QQ 私聊和群聊接进 DSH，提供 qq_send 等工具，让 agent 能回消息、发表情、等待对方接话。

description.en: Two-way sync between a local LaTeX folder and an Overleaf project over the Overleaf Socket.IO + OT channel instead of a Git bridge: pull with automatic git init, dry-run-first push, three-way diff, background watch, and conflict copies that never overwrite.
description.zh: 不走 Git 桥接，而是通过 Overleaf 自身的 Socket.IO + OT 通道在本地 LaTeX 文件夹与 Overleaf 项目之间双向同步：拉取后自动 git init、推送默认 dry-run、三方 diff、后台 watch，冲突永不覆盖而是另存副本。

description.en: Serves the OwlCoda RunKit skill in the DSH skill catalog: project-owned objectives, work items, candidate identity, verification receipts, handoffs and recovery stay in project artifacts. Installs instructions only; the project-local owlrunkit CLI is a separate setup step.
description.zh: 把 OwlCoda RunKit 技能加入 DSH 技能目录：目标、WorkItem、候选身份、验证回执、交接和恢复保存在项目工件中。只安装指令；项目本地的 owlrunkit CLI 仍需单独安装。

description.en: Inject a personal rules file into the DeepSeek Harness system prompt, with silent-step and repeated-action loop guards editable from the settings dialog.
description.zh: 把个性化规则文件注入 DeepSeek Harness 系统提示，并提供静默提醒与重复操作循环检测，可在设置弹窗中编辑。

description.en: Collects every DSH plugin sidebar entry into one collapsible floating dock at the corner of the Web GUI, with a switch that hides the original icon column and a deep-linked list of installed plugins.
description.zh: 把 DSH 左侧栏里所有插件的入口收进一张可折叠的浮动小卡片：顶部开关决定是否收起原侧栏图标列，点一行直达对应面板，另有全部已安装插件的深链列表。

description.en: Adds an optimize-prompt button to the left of the composer's send button; it rewrites the draft with the session's own model route and writes the result back through the normal editor path, so a single undo restores the original.
description.zh: 在输入框发送按钮左侧添加「优化提示词」按钮，用当前会话的模型路由改写草稿并通过编辑器原有路径原地回填，一次撤销即可还原原文。

description.en: Shows your Alibaba Cloud cash-coupon balance - the credit that pays for Qwen and DashScope calls - in the DSH sidebar, with an AccessKey form that keeps the key on your machine.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏显示阿里云代金券余额（抵扣千问 / 百炼调用的那笔钱），AccessKey 只保存在本机。

description.en: Collects the papers a DeepSeek Harness conversation cited, checks each one against Crossref, OpenAlex, arXiv and DataCite, and exports the confirmed entries as BibTeX or RIS.
description.zh: 收集对话里引用过的文献，逐条到 Crossref、OpenAlex、arXiv、DataCite 核对，通过核对的导出为 BibTeX 或 RIS。

description.en: Use SSH hosts and WSL distributions as remote DSH workspaces, with environment setup, model configuration porting, and the remote interface embedded locally.
description.zh: 将 SSH 主机与 WSL 发行版接入远程 DSH 工作区，支持环境安装、模型配置移植与本地内嵌远程界面。

description.en: Sets a per-session inference concurrency limit of 1–10 shared by the main agent and its descendants; at 1, the parent waits for child tasks to finish.
description.zh: 为每个主会话设置 1–10 条推理并发，主 Agent 与子孙共用额度；设为 1 时，父 Agent 等待子任务结束后再继续。

description.en: Import a public DeepSeek or Doubao chat share link into a DSH workspace as a static, resumable session.
description.zh: 把公开的 DeepSeek 或豆包对话分享链接导入 DSH 工作区，成为一个静态、可续聊的会话。

description.en: Collapsible section headers for the DSH sidebar: fold the functions list, the workspace list and the footer status area behind labelled header rows; sections are identified by position so cards the host or other plugins append to the footer join the status section automatically, and the account row stays pinned to the bottom (client-only DOM enhancement, no host patch).
description.zh: DSH 侧栏分区折叠：功能区、工作区、状态区三段各自独立收放，设置与账号那排钉死在最底部不随折叠移动；纯客户端 DOM 增强，不打宿主补丁。

description.en: Interface and code typography, three-color themes, and named presets for DeepSeek Harness, tested on Windows Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供界面和代码字体、三色主题及命名外观方案；已在 Windows 桌面版 0.2.1-rc.5 验证。

description.en: A neon pixel theme for DeepSeek Harness desktop with playable air-battle, pig-sling and fruit-slicing backgrounds, mouse controls and a day/night switch for the sling game.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面端霓虹像素主题，提供可参与的像素空战、愤怒的小猪和霓虹切水果背景，支持鼠标操作及小猪游戏昼夜切换。

description.en: Strinova theme: light/dark modes, a Cielle character illustration on the new-session screen, a corner character randomly picked on each page load with a matching composer placeholder line, and floating particles.
description.zh: 卡拉彼丘主题：日夜双模式；新会话页展示汐的角色立绘，右下角角色与输入栏台词按页面加载随机轮换，并点缀漂浮粒子。

description.en: Token dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: monthly budgets per provider, subscription quotas (GLM / Kimi Coding), account balances, and model cost/usage breakdowns — estimated locally, read-only, with error-classified diagnostic logs.
description.zh: DSH Token 看板：按供应商的月度预算、订阅配额（GLM / Kimi Coding）、账户余额与模型费用/用量明细——全程本地估算、只读本地数据，日志带错误分类便于排查。

description.en: Adds an 'Upgrades' tab to the DSH Plugins page: npm update checks for all installed plugins, engines.dsh compatibility preflight before upgrading, and one-click in-place upgrades that bypass pnpm's 24-hour release-cooling gate. Also refreshes the npm dependency families pulled in by GitHub-sourced bundles, and checks the Harness itself against the latest npm release.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件页新增「升级」标签：集中检查全部插件的 npm 新版本，升级前预检 engines.dsh 兼容性，一键原地升级并绕过 pnpm 的 24 小时发布冷却期； 支持刷新 GitHub 来源插件内含的依赖全家桶，并可检查 DSH 本体是否有新版。

description.en: Unofficial fork of dougen/dsh-deepseek-usage (baseline v0.16.0): sidebar balance and quota card for the active model provider, covering DeepSeek, Moonshot, Z.ai, OpenRouter, Kimi, MiniMax and OpenCode, plus Alibaba Cloud voucher balance for qwen-token-plan (BSS OpenAPI with AccessKey) and Xiaomi MiMo console balance with token-plan usage (console cookie). Ships a provider query-status page and per-token unit prices. Do not install it alongside upstream dsh-deepseek-usage: both render the same sidebar card.
description.zh: dougen/dsh-deepseek-usage 的非官方分支（基线 v0.16.0）：侧边栏余额与配额卡片，显示当前模型提供商的账户读数：DeepSeek、Moonshot、Z.ai、OpenRouter、Kimi、MiniMax、OpenCode；并为 qwen-token-plan 读取阿里云代金券余额（BSS OpenAPI + AccessKey），为小米 MiMo 读取控制台余额与套餐用量（控制台 Cookie）。另提供各提供商查询状态页与每 token 单价。不要与上游 dsh-deepseek-usage 同装：两者会渲染同一张侧边栏卡片。

description.en: Detects Minecraft mod and plugin projects (Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Architectury, Paper) and runs their Gradle client or server task from the session header, with launch logs in a sidebar tab. One-shot tasks such as data generation and GameTest report a pass or fail verdict when they finish.
description.zh: 识别工作区里的 Minecraft 模组与插件工程（Fabric、Forge、NeoForge、Architectury、Paper），在会话标题栏运行 Gradle 的客户端或服务端任务，日志显示在侧栏标签；数据生成与 GameTest 这类会跑完的任务在结束时给出通过或失败的结论。

description.en: Research Agent skills, literature search with citation tracking, document-to-markdown knowledge base builder, and in-depth reading with browser workbench for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 三木科研 Agent Skills 合集：多源学术检索与原位引文追溯、LaTeX/KaTeX 高精度文档解析转 Obsidian 知识库、证据链精读与完整科研工作台。

description.en: Global and project text memory with original-message citations, revision history and managed source withdrawal. Public beta.
description.zh: 保留原话引用、修改历史并支持受管来源撤回的全局与项目文字记忆。公开测试版。

description.en: Monochrome UI and motion with scoped styles, local skills, context recall and native agent collaboration.
description.zh: 黑白灰淡紫界面与动效、作用域样式、本机技能、上下文召回及原生智能体协作。

description.en: Fully local push-to-talk voice input for macOS: hold a global hotkey, speak, release — transcription is pasted at your cursor. Local-first STT (Qwen3-ASR 0.6B 4bit on MLX/Metal by default, SenseVoice and mlx-whisper fallbacks), zero external APIs, launchd self-healing service and an 8-point diagnose script. The bundled skill lets the agent install, configure (Karabiner hotkey wiring, launchd, engine switching) and troubleshoot the whole toolchain for you.
description.zh: macOS 本地按住说话语音输入：按住全局热键说话、松开即转写粘贴到光标处。纯本地 STT（默认 Qwen3-ASR 0.6B 4bit 走 MLX/Metal，SenseVoice / mlx-whisper 双 fallback），零外部 API，launchd 自愈常驻 + 8 项自检。内置技能让 agent 代你完成安装、Karabiner 热键接线、launchd 配置、引擎切换与全链排障。

description.en: Two PDF tools for the DSH sidebar in one install — jump to any page and browse the whole document with locally rendered pages and thumbnails, or open a PDF with DSH's native preview. Ships a /pdf command too.
description.zh: 一个包装两个 PDF 工具：按页码跳页、用本地渲染的页面和缩略图整本浏览，也可用 DSH 原生预览直接打开；另带一个 /pdf 命令。

description.en: Capture ideas, anywhere: the Ideas manager brings an idea backlog straight into the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 把灵感随手丢进看板，AI 帮你收集、评分和整理，想法不再散落各处。
